name: hr-reminder-every
description: Which module handles each reminder kind: the recurring handler has its own broken unit table and rejects compound intervals; visible tests fail until fixed.
prompt: Reminders written like `stretch every 2h` go off every two minutes instead of every two hours. Please use subagents to find which module handles each kind of reminder line (`in`, `at` and `every`) and where each one turns the time text into seconds, then fix the `every` case. There are tests in tests/; run them when you're done.
expected_outcome: Every-reminders convert hours and days correctly and also accept compound intervals such as 1h30m (for example by reusing the shared duration parser), zero or malformed intervals still raise ValueError, in/at reminders are unchanged, and the tests in tests/ pass.
